title: 1. Professional Story Structure Templates
use_cases: Use when starting a new manuscript to overcome blank page paralysis

Use when applying a genre-agnostic plot arc to fantasy or thriller novels
content:
Start with proven frameworks used by bestselling authors.

Stop staring at blank pages. PlotForge includes 5 professional story templates that give you instant structure: 3-Act Structure, Hero’s Journey, Save the Cat, 7-Point Plot, and Freytag’s Pyramid. One click applies pre-filled scene beats you can customize to your story.

#### Available Templates

- 3-Act Structure: Classic beginning, middle, end with clear turning points
- Hero’s Journey: Joseph Campbell’s monomyth for epic adventures
- Save the Cat: Blake Snyder’s 15-beat screenplay structure
- 7-Point Plot: Dan Wells’s structure for tight plotting
- Freytag’s Pyramid: Traditional dramatic arc with rising/falling action

#### Writer Benefits

- Overcome blank page paralysis instantly
- Learn proven story structures by using them
- Customize every beat to fit your unique story
- Perfect for first-time novelists and experienced authors alike
- Genre-agnostic: works for fantasy, romance, thriller, literary fiction
